name: USDCHF Mean Reversion Low Volatility
description: Mean reversion strategy on USDCHF using daily ATR as volatility filter. Enters long when volatility is low (daily ATR below its 10-period MA) and price is 1% below 50-period SMA. Exits when price crosses back above 50-SMA. Uses risk-based position sizing with 2% stop distance.
source:
# USDCHF Mean Reversion Low Volatility Strategy
# Entry: Low daily ATR + price 1% below 50-SMA
# Exit: Price crosses back above 50-SMA
# Risk: 2% risk per trade, 2% stop distance

# 4H data source (primary timeframe)
src = market_data_source(timeframe=4H)()
close = src.c

# Daily ATR for volatility filter (computed on 1D timeframe)
daily_atr = atr(period=14, timeframe=1D)()

# 10-period MA of daily ATR (inherits 1D timeframe from input)
daily_atr_ma = ma(period=10, type=MAType.sma)(daily_atr)

# Low volatility filter on daily timeframe: ATR below its 10-period MA
low_volatility_1d = daily_atr < daily_atr_ma

# Upsample the boolean to 4H by converting to numeric first
# 1.0 for low vol, 0.0 for high vol
low_vol_numeric = 1.0 if low_volatility_1d else 0.0

# Upsample to 4H using interpolation (which will forward-fill for step function)
low_vol_upsampled = upsample_by_interpolate(target_timeframe=4H)(low_vol_numeric)

# Convert back to boolean
low_vol_4h = low_vol_upsampled > 0.5

# 50-period SMA on 4H bars
sma_50 = ma(period=50, type=MAType.sma)(close)

# Entry condition: low volatility AND price at least 1% below 50-SMA
price_below_sma = close < sma_50 * 0.99
entry_signal = low_vol_4h and price_below_sma

# Exit condition: price crosses back above 50-SMA
exit_signal = crossover(close, sma_50)

# Hold signal from entry to exit
held_signal = hold_until()(enter=entry_signal, exit=exit_signal)

# Long zone executor
long_and_short_zone()(long_entry=held_signal)

# Risk-based position sizing: 2% risk, 2% stop distance
# stop_distance = 2% of price = close * 0.02
stop_distance = close * 0.02
risk_unit(stop_unit="percent")(risk_pct=2, stop_distance=stop_distance)
